app.name: Discord Wii U
app.short_description: Discord client for Nintendo Wii U
app.long_description:
A Discord client for the Nintendo Wii U (Aroma homebrew).
Features: - Real-time messaging via Discord Gateway WebSocket v10 - Server and channel list with permission filtering - Message history with avatars, timestamps, and scroll - @mention resolution and attachment display - Typing indicators and Direct Messages - On-screen touch keyboard (letters, numbers, symbols) - Discord dark theme at 1280x720
Controls: - D-Pad Up/Down: Navigate / scroll - D-Pad Left/Right: Switch panels - A: Select server or channel - B: Go back - Y: Open message input - ZL/ZR: Scroll messages - Minus (-): Open Direct Messages
Setup: 1. Place token in SD:/wiiu/discord_token.txt 2. Place a TTF font at SD:/wiiu/discord_wiiu/font.ttf 3. Launch from the Aroma Homebrew Launcher
